notes.title: Tempopo is a finalist for three Australian Game Developer Awards!
notes.content:
The only thing better than one AGDA is three AGDAs; it's awards season and Tempopo is making the rounds. 
Join us on October 8th as we (hopefully) take the stage at the Melbourne Convention & Exhibition Centre. And if we're not lucky enough to win, join us in congratulating which-ever team does! 



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45053652/531344f06156613cee9471ef186b5420b83d53cc.png"]
About the AGDAs[p align="start"]The Australian Game Developer Awards (AGDAs) are a national event celebrating outstanding games and individual achievements by the Australian game development community.
[p align="start"]Since 2020 The AGDAs have been run by the Interactive Games and Entertainment Association (IGEA) – the peak industry association representing the voice of Australian and New Zealand companies in the computer and video games industry.



Check out the official AGDA website for more information about the ceremony and other finalists.

notes.title: 250509 Update
notes.content:
We hope you’re enjoying Tempopo! With this update have a new feature to share with you: Hint Assist Mode! If you've enjoyed the hints that Hana can give you, turn this mode on and she’ll always show you the next spot to place instructions, to help you keep puzzling to rescue those musical flowers. 

This is particularly helpful for younger players, but you might find yourself needing to turn it on in some of the Winter or Challenge levels as well! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45053652/1e77907a028b9f57070c45704cf0daf0afb4d483.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45053652/1d73a8afd207060d1e9bd48e13e7def2857a983e.jpg

We've managed to squash a few tiny bugs as well, here's the full list of patch notes for you!

FEATURE

 Added Hint Assist Mode that automatically shows the next hint after placing an instruction


BUG FIXES

 Melody Garden flowers will no longer occasionally play their notes out of sync with the column highlighting
 Gallery images won't behave strangely in fullscreen mode if only one image was unlocked
 Linux controller icons would sometimes show up without a controller plugged in, but not anymore!

notes.title: 250420 update
notes.content:
Yesterday we believed we had fixed a rare game logic issue some users had encountered (Block Tempopo could get stuck in place, Uplift Tempopo lifting duration could be halved, Tempopo could turn invisible, and sounds could play at the wrong time), but after releasing the new build, we discovered the underlying cause. 

We believe it is now (really) fixed!

notes.title: 250419 update
notes.content:
We hope you're enjoying Tempopo! We've made a small update to fix a few things we've noticed since launch.

Fixes

fixed a vibration issue on Linux/Steam Deck
improved timing logic in Melody Garden to prevent double columns being triggered
switching seasons while playing music in Hana's Garden will no longer cause UI to appear
fixed issue where dragging instructions or flowers from the dock very quickly could cause unexpected behaviour
improved handling of resolution changing in the event that the game exits before the new resolution is confirmed

notes.title: Tempopo is out now! 🌷
notes.content:
It’s time, it’s time!

Tempopo is out now on Steam! 

[previewyoutube=w1mkkTm6IDQ;full][/previewyoutube]
Tempopo is a delightful and chaotic puzzle game, where you’ll instruct the Tempopo in how best to collect musical flowers to rebuild Hana’s lost garden. It’ll take you through four seasons of puzzles, collecting five different types of flowers, and you’ll have to avoid enemies like Chompers and Spike Bushes to solve these island puzzles and rescue the flowers. Hana will supervise and offer hints if you want them, and once you collect all the flowers within a season, lay them out in her garden, and she’ll conduct a tune for you. 

You can pick between Puzzle Mode, where you’ll have to figure out what instruction to give as well as where to place it, and Adventure Mode, which helps you out by letting you know which squares are viable spots (this is great for younger players too!)

And of course, that’s not all—we’ve also created a Melody Garden where you can compose your own tunes, (or recreate your favourites!), additional Challenge Levels for those puzzle fiends among you, and even a Creative Mode, where you can choose any number of instructions to give your Tempopo to solve a level. If you lose track of which Tempopo is which, remember that you can give them accessories in the Options menu!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45053652/e239e378c912bedcb45361b5c5435d567f2674af.jpg
Tempopo is a real labor of love for the Witch Beam team, and we’ve been working at it for quite some time (that’s how it ended up as a cameo in Unpacking!)

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45053652/d242f2f13442b8fe26ba6c990b48673ebf6c2906.jpg

We’re so glad that it’s out in the world now, and you can experience everything it has to offer. We love it very much.

As we’re a small studio, we appreciate all the love you can share, so if you feel inspired:

 Spread the word to your friends, family, and favorite streamers
 Leave a review
 Share the news on social media

(of course, there’s no obligation there! We appreciate you regardless!)

And please, if you compose a tune in the Melody Garden, please tag us on social media (Bluesky,  TikTok and Twitter) as we’d love to see it! 

But now we’ll leave you to it—go and play Tempopo!

Cheers,

Emily and the Witch Beam team

notes.title: Tempopo is coming out in ONE WEEK
notes.content:
Hello Tempeople!

We’re currently in the home stretch right now, as Tempopo releases in…LESS THAN A WEEK!

….and we can’t wait to hear what you think of it when it comes out. In terms of official details, we’ll be launching on April 17th at 16:00 GMT and if you’re wondering what that means for you, we’ve made a handy-dandy graphic!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45053652/0d5c237ea5c71d105ff7c2efb5c0ee5fae227759.jpg

If you had a chance to play the demo during Next Fest, you’ve got a lot to look forward to (and if you didn’t, you have even more!)


 60 total levels, across four seasons, which get progressively trickier as you play on!
 60 additional Challenge Levels once you complete the game—and they’re so hard that even I haven’t made it past the first one (complimentary)
 Got a younger player, or looking for some guard rails? You can play in Adventure Mode, where the solution squares are highlighted, letting you concentrate on putting the right instructions in the right spots.
 if you don't want any guard rails at all, you can turn on Creative Mode, where all instructions can be placed anywhere! This chaotic game mode favours players looking to find their own solutions without any help what so ever.
 Beautiful music to solve puzzles by, as well as the opportunity to create your own music!

We've also been sharing more songs from the Melody Garden, so here are a few to tide you over for the next week when you can make music of your own!

[previewyoutube=eJeFO2OAQME;full][/previewyoutube]
(and here's a palate cleanser for that ;) 

[previewyoutube=fhHbxDg3hwM;full][/previewyoutube]

See you all next week! 

Emily & the Witch Beam team
